benefits.name: TrueBlue Travel credit
benefits.notes: Up to $300 in statement credits per calendar year on hotels, car rentals, cruises and other bookings made through TrueBlue Travel (formerly Paisly by JetBlue). Before the April 2026 refresh it was $50 back per $250+ Paisly purchase, up to 6 times a year.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.notes: Up to $120 statement credit for the Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee every 4 years.

benefits.name: Anniversary 5,000 points
benefits.notes: 5,000 TrueBlue points each year after the account anniversary (from year two); value is an estimate (~1.3 cents/point).

benefits.name: 25-tile Mosaic bonus
benefits.notes: 25 Mosaic tiles credited after each calendar year-end toward next year's Mosaic status.

benefits.name: Companion pass ($15k spend)
benefits.notes: Companion pass worth up to $500, applied as a statement credit after travel, earned after $15,000 in eligible purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.name: Companion pass ($75k spend)
benefits.notes: Second companion pass worth up to $1,500, applied as a statement credit after travel, earned after $75,000 total eligible purchases in a calendar year.
